name: 77845 · College Sta, TX
findings: ZIP 77845 (College Sta) has 213 nonprofit organizations. 100 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77845 (College Sta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77845 (College Sta) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
